items.html: In this manner: the two portions are — one from the side of Aba, which is the MN of "manot," as you know, and one from the side of the Yesod of Ima, as stated above. And they are: "man" — this is the Yesod of Aba; "to his friend" — this is the Yesod of ZA. For even though Aba is great, when he descends to the place of the Yesod of ZA, he is called "his friend." In the manner of ZA, when he descends to Yetzirah, of whom it is said, "a man drew off his shoe and gave it to his friend."
